name: composure
description: See the stack your compose file declares, find out which file and line set each value, and edit compose files and Dockerfiles without reformatting them — one changed value is a two-line diff.
//categories: `Other` was dropped: it is the marketplace's dumping ground and adds no way to be found that the two accurate categories do not. `Formatters` is deliberately NOT claimed — this extension's whole property is that it never reformats a file.
//keywords: Capped at 5 by the marketplace. Chosen as five DISTINCT queries a searcher types, not five spellings of one: bare `compose` was dropped because the word is already in `description` and in `docker-compose`, and its slot went to `containers`.

composure.corePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a `composure` core binary. For development only — when empty the extension uses the binary shipped for this platform under `bin/<goos>-<goarch>/`. Machine-scoped on purpose: this names an executable to run, and a `.vscode/settings.json` committed to a repository must not be able to redirect it.

composure.dockerHub.markdownDescription: Whether Composure may ask Docker Hub how old an image is and what newer tags exist. This is the **only** part of Composure that leaves your machine; everything else is read from your files. Set to `off` and the panel is exactly what it is with no network: no upgrade pills, no image search, and no requests made. Anonymous Docker Hub allows 180 requests a minute per IP address, shared by everyone behind it.

//dependencies: Deliberately empty and asserted empty by host/packaging.test.ts. `make licence` walks the Go build graph and cannot see node_modules, so the only tree size that gate can vouch for is zero. NOTE: `npm install --save-dev` deletes this empty object; restore it by hand afterwards.
